fields.label: Costs
fields.description: How each column of the Employee CTC report is worked out (monthly). All the rows of a column that apply to the employee's category are added. A column without rows: Employee Contr PASI and Security Fund come from the PASI / Security Fund deductions of the salary slip, Air Fare from its airfare earning, Gratuity is the month's gratuity provision (Expats, as in EOS Statement), Leave Salary as above; the others are 0.
